mechanism: Oral contraceptives may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of carvedilol through estrogen-mediated effects on renin-angiotensin system and fluid retention, while carvedilol may theoretically increase oral contraceptive levels via hepatic metabolism inhibition.
action: Monitor blood pressure control in patients on this combination; norethindrone efficacy should remain adequate, but counsel on alternative contraception if blood pressure becomes difficult to control.
